stageLedger.result: The v3 runner completed 12 observation-valid units: 9 normal and 3 selected J1 diagnostic repetitions.

stageLedger.name: Second-action boundary localization
stageLedger.result: The repeated J1 boundary is the required food-rule-profile read followed by the client readiness and React commit interval.

validity.functionalOutcome: All three selected diagnostic J1 traces were SUCCESS. J3 normal observations remain observation-valid but INCOMPLETE and were excluded from candidate selection.

measurement.candidateSelection: J1; highest normal trusted-event-to-ready tail 546 ms
measurement.requiredReadValidation: The required food-rule-profile response was 200 and body-finished in all three selected diagnostic traces. The ancillary request tracker retained body-finish timeouts on unrelated requests; these do not invalidate the required read.

comparison.relationship: Both lock samples occurred before the second trusted event.

dbLockSampler.interpretation: A bounded local lock signal was observed before the second-action window; this run does not establish DB lock contention as the second-click cause or prove its absence elsewhere.

externalServiceObservation.interpretation: No listed provider route was observed in the browser trace, and the server-side Supabase target was the local runner override. External provider latency remains unmeasured and out of scope for this continuation.

interpretation.supported: Across three valid diagnostic J1 records, the required food-rule-profile read has a 312-395 ms response-header latency and 295.65-375.75 ms diagnostic route timing, followed by 129-163 ms from body finish to ready state. The same traces retain 53 total requests, 24 API requests, 241-360 overlaps, and a measurable React commit window.
interpretation.notSupported: The co-occurrence of auth cost, request fan-out, store timing, and React commits does not identify one causal variable. These records do not prove the global freeze root cause, hosted latency, or a production performance regression threshold.
interpretation.measurementGapClosed: The food-rule-profile route now emits diagnostic Server-Timing only when AIYA_PERF_DIAGNOSTIC=1; normal production responses are unchanged.

nextAction: Define one reversible single-variable A-B-A experiment around either required-read scheduling or post-response state/commit scheduling, after selecting one variable and one timing boundary. Do not combine them and do not begin Plan 2.
